classification: Research inference from pinned source, not an approved API or browser measurement.
depth_basis: Relative visual paint plane, not DOM nesting, CSS z-index or a measured distance. Raised/floating are conditional readings; see part and composition notes. Field/track roles are flush unless source demonstrates relief.
parent_semantics: Local part id or @host/@viewport; representative visual containment, not a promise of exact DOM ancestry. Same-element paint layers refer to the owning part. Composition parts are normalized references; donor root binds to mount when co-classed, otherwise is its child. Host overlays stay relative to @host.
composition_semantics: parts enumerates donor templates available at that mount, conditional on props and note. Reuse imports roles, never applies a second root paint. Recurse into donor compositions only when their mount is present and the consuming variant enables them. Menu submenu is explicitly recursive. A custom consumer child is outside the closed shipped-part census.

scope_limits: CSS selector census is lexical, not a standards CSS parser or computed-style engine. Variant conditions remain in source links.
Native OS popup/scrollbars/textarea resize grips have no Area-owned internal geometry; no invented subpart values.
Repeated rows/options/icons and arbitrary consumer content use templates; no per-instance expansion.
Hit-target-only and screen-reader-only records are accounted but have paint:none.
State fills on an existing plate retain the plate role; independent semantic markers and edge paint receive explicit records.
